headings.text: You can share the links with QR Code

blocks.html:
Live video sharing and viewing are done through a video streaming server. The server is accessed using the credentials provided by the Deploy App.

Deploy App credentials and streams

https://mtx.``**canadian-goose.pvarki.fi**``:4626/api/v1/direct/credentials

https://mtx.``**canadian-goose.pvarki.fi**``:4626/api/v1/direct/streams

Naming convention:

Stream path naming

*live/tool/callsign*

icu, gopro, uas, ipcam
